# Architect Review: WC03-LIVING-DOCS Living Document Update Pass

## Decision

Ready for Operator validation.

## Review Scope

Reviewed Implementer Report `champcity-ai/phase-05/implementer_report/WC03-LIVING-DOCS-living-document-update-pass`, commit `b619c00a3e5244502b7e84a083f2bdd8fc1e4641`, changed-file scope, and key living documents updated by the pass.

## Findings

The living-document update pass is accepted for Operator validation. The updated Project Roadmap now identifies `champcity-ai/phase-05/project_roadmap/WC03` as the current approved roadmap authority, marks Phase 06 as the next implementation phase, and carries Phase 06 through Phase 15 from the approved roadmap.

Project State no longer claims Phase 03 is active. It states Phase 04 is closed as a stabilization bridge, Phase 05 roadmap rebaseline is approved, Phase 06 is next, Artifact Registry and Workflow State are diagnostic/cache, and the application is not the reliable workflow controller until Phase 08 re-entry criteria are met.

Open Questions now records the Phase 05 answers and retains only implementation-detail questions. Project Observation Register now includes PROJ-OBS-010 and assigns it to Phase 12 Git automation and Operator abstraction. Project Profile, Decisions, Risks, REBASELINE_WORKFLOW_ROUTER_MODEL, ARTIFACT_AUTHORITY_MODEL, and WORKFLOW_AUTHORITY_CONTRACT were updated consistently with the Phase 05 baseline.

The commit changed planning/architecture documents and the Implementer Report pair only. No source code, package, lockfile, test, provider, or deployment files were changed.

## Validation

The fixed project validation lane was run by the Architect. Build and all 54 unit tests passed. Repository gates passed except `git_changed_file_scope`, which still flags Phase 05 artifacts as outside the old WC09 branch scope. This matches the Implementer Report and is not treated as a living-document rejection because the gate is still scoped to the earlier Phase 03/04 WC09 implementation branch.

The repository is clean after the Implementer commit.

## Non-Blocking Evidence Hygiene Notes

The Implementer Report still says commit hash is pending because the report was committed with the work. The actual reviewed commit is `b619c00a3e5244502b7e84a083f2bdd8fc1e4641`.

The Artifact Registry was updated as a metadata cache. Phase 05 baseline still treats Artifact Registry and Workflow State as diagnostic/cache until Phase 06.

## Operator Validation Target

Manual Operator validation should confirm:

1. Project Roadmap shows Phase 06 through Phase 15 and identifies Phase 06 as the next implementation phase.
2. Project State no longer says Phase 03 is active.
3. Project Observation Register includes PROJ-OBS-010.
4. Open Questions marks Phase 05 answers as answered and retains only actual implementation-detail questions.
5. No source code changed.
